summary: SkyAI, Inc. (f/k/a Sharps Technology Inc.) filed an 8-K reporting a name change and strategic transformation. On May 26, 2026, it filed a Certificate of Amendment with Nevada to rename to SkyAI, Inc., effective without shareholder vote. The common stock and warrants began trading under new tickers SKYA and SKYAW on May 28, 2026. The company announced a pivot from legacy operations to an agentic finance platform leveraging AI and blockchain for emerging markets. No transaction terms, premiums, or dates are involved; this is a routine corporate rename and business strategy shift. The filing does not constitute a special situation event.
